Date: Nov 18, 2026

Location: Bangalore, KA, IN

Company: NTT DATA Services

Req ID: 386565 

NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.

We are currently seeking a Business Analyst to join our team in Bangalore, Karnātaka (IN-KA), India (IN).

Business Analyst – ServiceNow Platform Team

Position Summary

We are seeking a detail-oriented Business Analyst with ServiceNow experience to partner with business stakeholders, product owners, and technical teams in delivering platform enhancements, process improvements, and enterprise technology solutions. This role will include responsibilities for working with the platform team to gather and document requirements, analyze business processes, support Agile delivery, and coordinate testing.

Key Responsibilities

  • Partner with business stakeholders, product owners, process owners, and technical teams to gather, analyze, and document business needs and functional requirements.
  • Translate business requirements into clear user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, decision logs, and functional documentation.
  • Assist with facilitating requirements workshops, stakeholder interviews, backlog refinement sessions, sprint planning discussions, demos, and user acceptance testing activities.
  • Analyze current-state business processes, identify gaps or inefficiencies, and recommend practical improvements that align with platform capabilities and business goals.
  • Collaborate with ServiceNow administrators, developers, architects, QA resources, and delivery leads to clarify requirements and validate solution designs.
  • Create and maintain documentation including business requirements, functional specifications, process maps, test scenarios, training materials, knowledge articles, and release notes.
  • Use ServiceNow Strategic Portfolio Management (SPM) to manage demands, user stories, enhancements, defects, and agile development processes

Required Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience as a Business Analyst, Product Analyst, Functional Analyst, or similar role supporting enterprise systems or technology initiatives.
  • Agile, Lean-Agile, Scaled Agile, or related certification.
  • Hands-on experience working on the ServiceNow Strategic Portfolio Management (SPM) module with practical experience managing work in Demand Management, Collaborative Work Management, and Strategic Planning capabilities
  • Strong understanding of business analysis practices, including requirements elicitation, process mapping, gap analysis, documentation, and stakeholder management.
  • Experience working in Agile or hybrid delivery environments, including user story creation, backlog refinement, sprint planning, and acceptance criteria definition.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical audiences and translate business needs into actionable delivery requirements.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, facilitation, and organizational skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities, work independently, and deliver high-quality documentation in a fast-paced environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting ServiceNow implementations, upgrades, platform modernization efforts, or cross-functional workflow automation initiatives.
  • Experience preparing executive summaries, status updates, process documentation, training guides, or adoption materials.
  • Experience supporting testing activities, including test case development, UAT coordination, defect triage, and business validation.

About NTT DATA

NTT DATA is a $30 billion business and technology services leader, serving 75% of the Fortune Global 100. We are committed to accelerating client success and positively impacting society through responsible innovation. We are one of the world's leading AI and digital infrastructure providers, with unmatched capabilities in enterprise-scale AI, cloud, security, connectivity, data centers and application services. our consulting and Industry solutions help organizations and society move confidently and sustainably into the digital future. As a Global Top Employer, we have experts in more than 50 countries. We also offer clients access to a robust ecosystem of innovation centers as well as established and start-up partners. NTT DATA is a part of NTT Group, which invests over $3 billion each year in R&D.

Whenever possible, we hire locally to NTT DATA offices or client sites. This ensures we can provide timely and effective support tailored to each client’s needs. While many positions offer remote or hybrid work options, these arrangements are subject to change based on client requirements. For employees near an NTT DATA office or client site, in-office attendance may be required for meetings or events, depending on business needs. At NTT DATA, we are committed to staying flexible and meeting the evolving needs of both our clients and employees.
